keyEvents.text: Delay in match because of an injury Maroan Sannadi (Athletic Club).
Substitution, Athletic Club. Robert Navarro replaces Maroan Sannadi because of an injury.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Athletic Club 1, Real Sociedad 0. Iñaki Williams (Athletic Club) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Nico Williams with a through ball.
Goal! Athletic Club 1, Real Sociedad 1. Luka Sucic (Real Sociedad) left footed shot from outside the box to the bottom right corner.
Goal! Athletic Club 2, Real Sociedad 1. Alex Berenguer (Athletic Club) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the centre of the goal.
